text: 目前多数城市已经取消了住房贷款利率下限，但仍维持在3%以上。广州此前便有银行将住房贷款下调至3%以下，随后均又调回3%。不过，汇丰银行广州分行称，住房贷款利率最低可至2.7%。“未来银行个人住房贷款利率大体上也不会降，3%基本上是底线了，只能说只针对部分特定客户可以给到2.7%。”上海易居房地产研究院副院长严跃进对记者表示，此类最低利率门槛很高，并非人人都能享受，更像是一种针对特定人群的“价格战”。（每经）
text_en: Most cities have already removed the floor on housing loan rates, but rates remain above 3%. In Guangzhou, some banks had previously lowered housing loans below 3%, but all later reverted to 3%. However, HSBC's Guangzhou branch said housing loan rates can go as low as 2.7%. "In the future, banks' individual housing loan rates will generally not drop either; 3% is basically the bottom line. Only for certain specific clients can 2.7% be offered." Yan Yuejin, deputy director of Shanghai E-House Real Estate Research Institute, told reporters that such minimum rate thresholds are very high and not accessible to everyone, more like a "price war" targeting specific groups.
